findings.message: Upward reference: Format_Lib (foundation) -> Claims_BL (core). Move the consumed element to a lower layer.
Side reference between End-User modules: Portal -> Claims_FE. Move the shared element to Core (business) or a Library (agnostic).
Cycle between modules: Customer_CS <-> Policy_CS. Move elements, merge, or add a composition module on top.
Cycle between applications: Claims <-> Portal (they must be deployed together).
Side reference between End-User apps: Claims -> Portal. Move the shared modules (and their dependencies) into a Core app.
Side reference between End-User apps: Portal -> Claims. Move the shared modules (and their dependencies) into a Core app.
Upward application reference: Common (foundation app) -> Claims (end-user app). Move the shared modules (and their dependencies) into a Core/Foundation app.
Core sublayer violation: Claims_CS (core service) -> Claims_Sync (_SYNC). A CS must not depend on BL/CW/API/Sync/Eng; move the consumed element down into a CS.
Portal: no canvas suffix; assumed End-User. Add a suffix or an explicit "layer".
